definition: **Strike** — cessation of work by body of workmen acting in concert, with common understanding, to press demands. **Lock-out** — employer closes workplace or suspends work to compel acceptance of terms. Both are **weapons of collective economic pressure** but are **regulated**: notice periods, bans during conciliation/adjudication, and illegality if violent or in essential services (where applicable).
